card.name: Just before a formula or equation
card.fires_on: Linking words like "is" or "simply", or an opening parenthesis or digit, right before a formula is stated, such as "maximum heart rate is 220 minus age" or the Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance equation.

modes.label: Verb before a formula
modes.description: "is" or "simply" leads into a stated equivalence or rule.

modes.label: Start of the equation
modes.description: A parenthesis or the digit 1 opens the (140 - age) part of the creatinine clearance formula.
